about: Substrate's Fly provider as it ships (volter-ai/browser-substrate 3116b2e3f713, packages/sandboxes/src/fly-provider.ts, its types removed), whose own fetch calls the Machines API with the app-scoped token, app and organization the World's credential door issues as FLY_API_TOKEN, FLY_APP and FLY_ORG: it allocates Ada's workspace (the app probed, a volume made, a machine created with it mounted, waited on and read), pauses it (stop, wait) and resumes it (start, wait), and lists the running sandboxes. Substrate pins no Fly SDK. The World's operator enrolls the fake machine pool first (the kernel's machine-pool door): it records each run and runs no image, so the entry proves the API's answers and stored state, never a guest. The readback reads the running sandbox, its machine and its volume back without starting anything.
